name: Jeddah Tower
scope: The 120-floor Jeddah Tower construction snapshot documented in the 2 November 2026 investor release. The exterior includes the tapered wings, exposed structural decks, incomplete window panels, work platforms and cranes.

references.filename: Jeddah Tower Under Construction in 2026 After Reaching the 100th Floor.jpg
references.caption: A 2026 photo of Jeddah Tower in Jeddah under construction after reaching the 100th floor, with cranes visible at the top and sunset light reflecting on the glass façade against a cloudy evening sky.

originalReview.notes: Exact May photograph shows the exposed horizontal slab edges, broad concrete wing tips, lower silver-blue curtain wall patches, ochre work decks and luffing cranes. Sunset colors are not treated as material colors.

review.method: Exact published Qualla hero and native contemporary creator CC0 release
review.notes: Reviewed the Qualla article before seeking other sources. Used its exact CC0 hero, which matches the original creator upload. The two published attribution-only photos were excluded. All supplementary architectural and construction evidence is textual or open footprint data.
